Name: Xtarfur Valley 1.6
Author: Plebby999
Description:
A conversion to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399?tab=description]Xtardew Valley[/url]. I also tweaked a few portraits and sprites, made an anthro version of Rasmodia, a few NPCs and added a config to swap to Classic for Olivia.
I've also added a small patch for those using the new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37617?tab=description]Xtardew - Milfs And Poly And More - Old Events Restoration Project Mod[/url] released recently with re-added cut content.

[b]Installation:[/b]
Install all the requirements for ACC and Xtardew Valley.
Overwrite the portraits and sprites.
For the optional mod make sure to overwrite Xtardew Valley with Xtardew -[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37617?tab=description] [/url]MPM and then overwrite it's Portraits & Sprites with the files my optional mod brings.
